title_en: Funny Stories from Life (12/20): Grandpa Gets Hooked on Livestream Shopping
note_en: Chinese internet slang has colorful words for shopping: 剁手 (duòshǒu, literally "chop off your hand") means impulsive online buying, and 种草 (zhǒngcǎo, literally "plant grass") means getting someone hooked on wanting a product: 都被同一款煎锅种了草 "both got hooked on the same frying pan." Notice the passive 被: the person who gets "grass planted" is the subject, much like English "got sold on."
